WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM signals
),
kept AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.overall_avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.overall_avg_modindex
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_modindex,
  avg_modindex - overall_avg_modindex AS above_baseline,
  avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept;
